title: Capture Booth
summary: The Capture panel arms source lanes, monitors inputs and lists fresh captures for Foley and sound design.
alternateQueries: How do I grab a sound?

blocks.text: The Capture Booth is a small recording view: arm a source lane (Arm), monitor its input (Input), and grab fresh material. While recording it shows "Recording: <name>"; when stopped, "Capture stopped." Recent captures are listed, or "No captures yet."
For arranging recordings on the timeline use the Tracker; see the recording topic.
